sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Commercial CGI Visual Effects and 3D Character Animation

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Luxembourg (Grand Duchy of Luxembourg) - unitary national jurisdiction without sub-state tax differentiation
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic codified system with French/Belgian commercial-law heritage; unitary national law for the entire territory)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg-China Double Taxation Agreement, signed 10 June 2019, in force since 5 January 2020
United States-Luxembourg Income Tax Treaty of 3 April 1996, as amended by the Protocol of 20 May 2009
Luxembourg-France, Luxembourg-Germany, Luxembourg-Netherlands, Luxembourg-United Kingdom and Luxembourg-Italy double taxation agreements, as amended by the Multilateral Instrument
Luxembourg-Singapore and Luxembourg-United Arab Emirates DTAs (principal non-EU treaty hubs for cross-border payment rails)
EU treaties on freedom of establishment and free movement of capital applicable to intra-EU investors

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies, as amended by the Law of 12 July 2013 introducing Articles 63-1 et seq. for the SCSp and by the Law of 23 July 2016 on the registration of certain partnerships; Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended (AML/CFT Law, notably Articles 1(10), 3 and 3-1 on beneficial owners and politically exposed persons); Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners, as amended by the Law of 25 March 2020 and aligned with the CJEU judgment of 22 November 2022 in joined cases C-37/20 and C-601/20; CSSF Regulation No. 12-02 of 14 December 2012, as amended; EU Regulations 2015/847 and (EU) 2018/1672 on information accompanying fund transfers.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (RBE access restricted to competent authorities, AML/CFT obliged entities and parties demonstrating a legitimate interest; no unlimited public access following the CJEU ruling of 22 November 2022)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity document of each SCSp partner and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public, competent civil-status authority or consulate in the partner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Hague Convention of 5 October 1961, effective in Luxembourg since 4 April 1979); consular legalization by a Luxembourg embassy or consulate where the issuing state is not a Hague member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Extract from the commercial register and certificate of good standing of a corporate general partner, issued within the 30 days preceding authentication
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registrar or registry of commerce of the general partner's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the registry is located in a contracting state; otherwise consular legalization through the Luxembourg diplomatic post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney authorizing a Luxembourg-licensed counsel or domiciliation agent to sign, file and represent the SCSp in incorporation and RBE procedures
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each partner or the board of the corporate general partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or consular legalization of the signature block; eIDAS-compliant LuxTrust electronic signature accepted for Luxembourg-resident signatories

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO identification form and beneficial-ownership declaration mapping each individual to the 25% ownership and control threshold
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each partner and the admitting notary or fiduciary counter-signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Physical signature verified by notary or authorized KYC agent; apostille generally unnecessary where countersigned by a Luxembourg notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address for each partner, dated within the last 90 days
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility supplier, bank or municipal authority of the place of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified copy by a notary or public officer; apostille not required where the copy is certified for AML file purposes

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-signature screening of all general partners, limited partners, UBOs and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List and the UK HMT Consolidated List, applying the politically exposed person definitions and risk-based customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence standards of the Law of 12 November 2004, FATF Recommendations 12 and 22 and CSSF Regulation 12-02. Screening results must be documented in the KYC file; any PEP or sanctions match automatically escalates to enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval. The unregulated CGI/3D-animation business qualifies as Low_Risk_Standard, permitting simplified CDD for corporate partners established in EU-equivalent jurisdictions, while all individual partners remain subject to full CDD.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - lbr.lu, hosting the RCS (Registre de Commerce et des Societes) and the RBE (Registre des Beneficiaires Effectifs)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The SCSp denomination must contain, as a mandatory suffix, the letters 'SCSp' or the full words 'Societe en Commandite Speciale'. Names must be written in Latin script; French is the register's working language, with German and Luxembourgish equally admitted. A foreign-language or non-Latin-script brand must be transliterated into the Latin-script registered denomination. The registered name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing RCS entry, nor contravene public policy or prior trademark rights.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque, Bank, Credit, Caisse d'Epargne (prior CSSF authorization mandatory)
Assurance, Reassurance, Courtier d'Assurance (prior Commissariat aux Assurances authorization mandatory)
Fiduciaire, Fiduciary, Bureau Comptable (protected professional titles requiring Chamber of Commerce or professional-body authorization)
OPC, OPCVM, SICAV, SICAF, FCP, Fonds d'Investissement (regulated collective-investment tokens requiring CSSF authorization)
Societe Anonyme, SA, SARL, SCS, SCA (legal-form tokens inconsistent with the SCSp form are prohibited)

Luxembourg, Etat du Luxembourg, Ministere, Administration Publique (tokens falsely implying state sponsorship are prohibited; the word 'Luxembourg' alone is permissible where the registered office is located in Luxembourg)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On refusal, the LBR issues a reasoned rejection notice. Step 1: file a written re-evaluation request with the LBR assistance service within 15 days of the notice, providing evidence of trademark coexistence or ministerial authorizations. Step 2: if the rejection is confirmed, lodge an appeal within 3 months of notification before the Tribunal Administratif of Luxembourg under the Law of 21 June 1999, with no suspensive effect; the administrative decision may be further appealed to the Administrative Court within one month of service. Step 3: in parallel, petition the District Court of Luxembourg sitting in commercial matters for an order directing registration where the refusal rests on commercial-law objections. The 30-day reservation cannot be extended; a fresh reservation with a corrected denomination must be filed without delay while any appeal is pending.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible with substance safeguards. The SCSp must maintain a registered office in Luxembourg capable of receiving service of process; a professional domiciliation agent licensed under the Law of 31 May 1999 may provide the address. For an online 3D-animation producer, a virtual office is accepted for registration, provided the general partner, board decision-making, bookkeeping centre and bank account management are demonstrably located and conducted in Luxembourg to support tax residence and OECD BEPS substance expectations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated below 5% annual probability). The unregulated animation/VFX activity does not trigger routine on-site supervision by the CSSF or the Financial Intelligence Unit; primary compliance is documentary through RBE filings, domiciliation-agent AML audits and bank CDD reviews. Unannounced physical verification may nevertheless occur in tax-audit, AML-inspection or enforcement scenarios and should be anticipated by maintaining a physically accessible Luxembourg workspace or sublicensed meeting facility.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: LBR online name availability check and 30-day name reservation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: LBR official tariff; reservation fee EUR 30-50, search free online via lbr.lu

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Electronic filing of the SCSp incorporation dossier with the RCS commercial register
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: LBR fee schedule; approximately EUR 250-280 for electronic filing

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as consolidated, Articles 102-1 to 102-27 (Société en Commandite Spéciale, inserted by Law of 23 July 2016); Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies and Company Records; Law of 13 January 2019 on the Register of Beneficial Owners.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), acting through the notary or an approved e-filing intermediary.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration en vue de l'inscription (electronic registration form C) submitted via the LBR portal, with the executed partnership deed annexed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; freedom of contribution (cash, in-kind or industry) as set in the partnership deed; paid-up amount is agreed contractually and not lodged in escrow; each limited partner's liability is capped at the amount of its agreed contribution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers hereby approve and adopt the formation deed of the SCSp and the subscription and contribution obligations set out therein; RESOLVED, that the initial capital contribution be deemed subscribed and accepted as recorded in the deed; RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at the address stated in Article 1 of the deed, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg; RESOLVED, that the General Partner be appointed sole Manager (Gérant) with exclusive power to represent the partnership, open bank accounts and execute client and supplier contracts; RESOLVED, that the Manager is instructed to complete RCS registration, RBE beneficial-ownership filing, VAT and tax formalities, and to take every action necessary to commence commercial 3D animation activities; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the common seal, if any, be entrusted to the Manager.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – RCS online prior-name-check module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit proposed legal name to the RCS search tool; ensure the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing entity and that it includes 'SCSp' or 'Société en Commandite Spéciale' as the legal-form suffix; record the availability confirmation for the deed.
required_dossiers: Identity of subscribers or candidate names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, file a new availability check with alternative names; no material prejudice, as no filing fee has yet been paid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the constitutive partnership deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Autonomous signature by partners before LuxTrust e-signature or before a Luxembourg notary (optional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the partnership agreement (acte constitutif) containing identity of partners, contribution amounts, duration, profit-share clauses, manager appointment and registered office address; execute the deed by authentic act before a notary or by private writing with certified electronic signatures; a French or English text may be used, with a French extract for RCS publication if required.
required_dossiers: Passport or ID of all partners and the manager
Proof of registered office address or letter of intent from the landlord
Bank confirmation of contribution payments (if made before filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or e-signature agent identifies defects, rectify the deed by a corrective rider or re-execute the relevant signature page before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – RCS electronic filing desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the registration form (Form C) electronically with the executed deed attached; the submission must be made by the manager or an approved intermediary with LuxTrust credentials; pay the official fee online and receive an acknowledgment with a provisional registration number.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of partners and manager
Proof of registered office (lease or authorisation)
Extract from the criminal record of manager (if individual, issued within 3 months)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query, respond within the granted delay (generally 1 month) by providing the missing annexes or a corrected registration form; a deed amendment may be filed if the query concerns statutory clauses; failure to cure leads to formal rejection and a new filing with a supplementary fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon completion of RCS registration, the registry automatically transmits the legal-form extract to RESA for publication; the manager shall verify the published extract within 5 days and confirm that the registered office, manager and capital details are correct.
required_dossiers: Legal-form excerpt (dépôt légal) prepared by intermediary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the publication contains errors, request a rectification through the LBR portal and file a correction notice; no legal third-party effects arise where the published text is erroneous and timely corrected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation registrations: RBE, VAT, social security and employer duties
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE); Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File beneficial-ownership declaration with the RBE within one month of registration; submit VAT registration form, as commercial animation services are subject to VAT; register as an employer with CCSS if hiring staff; open a corporate bank account for subscription payments; obtain an electricity and cable connection contract for the commercial studio.
required_dossiers: List of beneficial owners (25%+ ownership or control)
Bank account opening documents (partnership deed, RCS extract, identification)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RBE submission is queried for incomplete ownership data, amend the declaration online; VAT registration delays may be cured by applying retroactively with interest and penalties limited where good faith is shown; CCSS registration can be regularised by backdating contributions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – ISIC 5911 / NAICS 512110 (commercial CGI and 3D animation) is an office-based professional service with no industrial manufacturing process; the Ministry of the Economy (General Directorate for Industry) does not require a business establishment authorisation for this unregulated activity.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no statutory operating licence for CGI/VFX production; workplace compliance is covered by general labour inspection; if the studio operates an in-house render farm with high energy load, an electrical installation report is required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – activity is not listed in the classes of establishments subject to an environmental impact assessment under the Law of 31 May 1999 on environmental permitting and the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 10 June 2011; no Class 1-4 environmental authorisation is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater discharge; office wastewater is connected to municipal sewers; waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEE) and toner cartridges must be segregated and collected by an approved waste operator; any standby generator or cooling system for the render farm must comply with noise limits under the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 15 December 2010 and F-gas rules under Regulation (EU) No 517/2014.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the Administration des services de secours (CGDIS) for commercial premises, including emergency exits, extinguishers, smoke detection and evacuation plan; occupational health and safety inspection by the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) covering workstations (screens, ergonomic chairs, lighting) and electrical safety verified by an approved controller; structural load check of building floors if heavy render servers are installed; completion of a workplace risk assessment in accordance with Article L.312-1 of the Luxembourg Labour Code.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) for direct taxes; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT; official portals MyGuichet.lu / Guichet.lu and electronic filing platform Edp-tax.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned SCSp engaged in 3D animation, the partnership must first be registered with the Luxembourg Business Registers (RCSL) to obtain its national identification number (matricule); no minimum capital, tax clearance, or prior industry license is required. If the SCSp makes supplies with a Luxembourg VAT place of supply, it must apply separately to the AEDT for a Luxembourg TVA identification number using the standard registration procedure; a non-established taxable person may be required to appoint a Luxembourg tax representative for VAT. The SCSp is fiscally transparent for direct tax, so partners obtain or update their Luxembourg tax files with the ACD and report their distributive shares in their respective tax returns.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No domestic 'check-the-box' regime exists in Luxembourg. An SCSp is transparent by default; it may elect VAT grouping ('assujetti unique') under Article 60 of the Luxembourg VAT Law, may waive the EUR 35,000 small-enterprise exemption, and may request an advance tax ruling from the ACD to confirm its transparent treatment. Cross-border hybrid mismatches are governed mandatorily by Luxembourg's ATAD implementation (law of 29 March 2019) and no separate domestic opacity election is available for a standard SCSp.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT / Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for established taxable persons under the small-enterprise exemption; non-established suppliers have no domestic turnover threshold and must register from the first taxable supply with a Luxembourg place of supply, subject to OSS and distance-selling special schemes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not currently impose real-time fiscal clearance, API-based reporting, or digital stamping for B2B VAT invoices. VAT invoices must be issued no later than the 15th day of the month following the taxable supply and must satisfy the content requirements of the Luxembourg VAT Law; e-invoicing is accepted without prior approval. In the public-procurement context, e-invoices must comply with EN 16931 and may be exchanged through Peppol. The EU VAT in the Digital Age framework is expected to introduce mandatory e-invoicing and digital transaction reporting for Luxembourg taxpayers from 2030.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For physical exports, the 0% export VAT rate applies only where tangible goods are dispatched or transported outside the EU by the supplier or on its behalf and the supplier holds documentary proof of departure. For commercial 3D animation and VFX services, if the customer is established outside the EU, the place of supply of the B2B service is outside Luxembourg and the supply is not taxable in Luxembourg; B2C digital supplies to non-EU consumers likewise fall outside Luxembourg VAT. The SCSp may recover attributable input VAT to the extent allowed under Luxembourg deduction rules and must retain records evidencing the non-EU customer's identity, establishment, and delivery/receipt of the service.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic Single Administrative Document / EXS) for physical goods; for digital animation deliverables, equivalent service export evidence comprising contract, delivery/IP transfer logs and customer tax registration
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or CMR/other transport document proving departure of goods from the EU
Inward Remittance Certificate or matched SWIFT/bank credit evidence showing payment from the non-EU customer
Commercial invoice, purchase order, packing list and non-EU customer VAT/tax identification
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEDT and ACD auditors may require production of the complete export evidence set within the ordinary five-year assessment period, extended to ten years in fraud cases. If export evidence is missing, false, or the goods/services are subsequently diverted or used in the EU, the claimed 0% treatment is reversed and Luxembourg VAT becomes payable at 17.0%, together with statutory late interest and administrative penalties. Fraudulent zero-rating may trigger criminal prosecution with fines up to EUR 250,000 and imprisonment, and may disqualify the entity from future zero-rating or input VAT recovery.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL) together with Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) for payment and banking supervision; exchange of reporting data via the BCL's statistical balance of payments declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg maintains full current and capital account convertibility, with no exchange controls or capital movement restrictions other than EU sanctions and Funds Freezing Regulations. Profit remittance is freely permitted without withholding for distributions to eligible EU/EEA and treaty partners, subject to anti-abuse provisions and substance requirements. For a pass-through SCSp, no entity-level tax is imposed; distributions follow the underlying partner fiscal attributes and treaty protections, so no convertibility hurdle exists for legally documented commercial profit transfers in euro or other G10 currencies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion timetable exists under Luxembourg law. Exporters may retain receipts in any eligible currency, hold them freely on non-resident-capable accounts, and settle commercial liabilities exclusively in contractual currency. Only BCL statistical reporting thresholds (balance-of-payments categories, usually monthly reporting if cumulative transactions exceed EUR 250,000 or on declaration request) and EU sanctions screening obligations apply.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility is Medium-High only when the EMI holds a valid EU/EEA passport under PSD2 and is registered with the CSSF. Luxembourg-established licensed EMI entities such as those under the law of 21 December 2023 on payment institutions and electronic money institutions offer the highest viability for an IP-heavy 3D animation SCSp. Fully offshore EMIs that lack a physical EU establishment, are not wallet-eligible under the local AML law, or cannot support a legal capital escrow arrangement are rated Low viability because they trigger higher concentration risk and may reject service to a partnership structure without an established track record.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory mandate requires directors or ultimate beneficial owners to appear physically in Luxembourg. The revised Luxembourg Law of 12 November 2004 and CSSF AML/CFT directives permit fully remote client identification by means of qualified electronic signature, video identification, and certified copies from a notary/trustee. Nevertheless, most systemic tier-1 banks maintain an internal risk policy requiring at least one initial in-person interview (either at the partner level or through an existing relationship bank branch) for non-resident partners and for SCSp entities with no audited financials. Remote opening is conditionally accepted using centralized e-KYC providers if the beneficial owner's jurisdiction is rated non-high-risk and source-of-wealth documentation is provided.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unregulated legal form of SCSp and multi-layered partnership structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the partnership agreement (contrat de société), recent extract from the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS), beneficial owner register extract (RBE), organizational chart showing the full chain of ownership, the factual explanation of the partnership purpose, and a substantiated business plan for CGI/3D animation production with counterparty identification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident partners domiciled in a non-European jurisdiction or a jurisdiction classified by FATF as having increased monitoring
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified passport copies, tax residency certificates from the partner's jurisdiction, bank reference letter from the partner's principal bank, source-of-wealth declaration, source-of-funds proof covering capital injection, and a notarized decree or board consent from the partner corporate entity confirming the subscription.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value project contracts with hidden sub-contractors or royalty streams typical of animation service agreements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed project service agreement or master commercial contract, issuer-approved statement of work, public proof of pre-existing commercial relationship, treasury flow forecasts, validation of all legal and beneficial owners of each intragroup licensed entity, and an external AML compliance opinion from a Luxembourg legal advisor.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound transfers are executed via SWIFT MT103 with the BCL balance-of-payments code 'P' (Foreign direct investment in Luxembourg) when capital is injected in the form of partnership capital. Purpose codes must be stated as 'Capital subscription / increase' or equivalent; the account reference must be the partner's capital account identification and the SCSp's RCS number. Banks require verification of origin of funds via anti-money laundering standard, including the underlying partnership agreement, notarized capital increase minutes, and Luxembourg tax form 570 if a UK or other treaty jurisdiction is involved. For euro-area resources, TARGET2 is used as the clearing rail, while non-euro resources enter through correspondent banks, and all inbound amounts are subject to non-resident interest reporting thresholds only for individually identifiable commercial lending, not for partner share capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement of production invoices (CGI rendering, voice talent, licensing, software subscriptions) is executed either through SEPA CT (for euro-denominated EU counterparties) or SWIFT MT103 for intercontinental payments. For large bespoke equipment or commission-heavy delivery milestones, a documentary commercial letter of credit under UCP 600 may be issued by a tier-1 bank, with SCSp drawn amounts reconciled against the limited partnership's commercial agreement. Payment instructions require the purpose code classification of trade-in services (series 200) or royalties (series 300) as defined by the BCL balance-of-payments manual, plus the relevant counterparty LEI when applicable, and the submission of the underlying invoice to the bank's cash-processing unit for screening above EUR 10,000 equivalent.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla FX forwards for non-speculative hedging of production costs (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/JPY) pursuant to board-approved FX policy
FX swaps (spot-forward combination) for liquidity management of short-term net trading settlements
Cross-currency interest rate swaps in G10 currencies for funding infrastructure and partnership-level financing hedging under ISDA/CSA secured collateral arrangements

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies without full convertibility or restricted offshore availability, subject to the CSSF's EMIR reporting and clearing thresholds and a clear non-speculative underlying exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: RCS Annual Declaration of Conformity (declaration annuelle de conformite)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Societes (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after each anniversary of the entity's RCS registration date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty imposed by RCS for omission; defaulting entities receive a formal default notice and are struck off ex officio (radiation) from the RCS if no compliance occurs within 15 days

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO register annual confirmation and change report (Registre des beneficiaires effectifs - RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE) operated by LBR/RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: UBO confirmation is bundled with the RCS annual declaration and is due within one month of the registration anniversary; any change in beneficial ownership must be filed within one month of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fines from EUR 1,250 up to EUR 250,000 and potential imprisonment for managing general partners for wilful non-declaration or false declaration; persistent default exposed to strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts preparation and filing (depot des comptes annuels) under Luxembourg GAAP
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RCS via LBR electronic filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after the close of the financial year (typically 31 July for calendar-year accounts); exemption applies where all general partners are Luxembourg legal entities publishing their own accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Commercial Court may order compliance under a penalty payment (astreinte) of up to EUR 500 per day of delay; fines up to EUR 2,500; repeated non-filing triggers ex officio strike-off proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Partnership annual tax information return (declaration d'impot - societe de personnes / Form 500)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD - Luxembourg direct tax authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months of the tax year end (31 March for calendar-year accounts); ACD routinely grants administrative extension to 31 December for electronic filers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines; default interest at 0.6% per month on any assessed amounts; ex officio assessment with a 10% surcharge when no return is lodged within deadline

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal business tax declaration (impot commercial communal) - required if commercial activity is carried on through a Luxembourg permanent establishment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) and the commune of the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same filing window as the partnership income tax return (31 March for calendar-year accounts, with administrative extension to 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default interest at 0.6% per month; ex officio assessment with surcharge; general partners may be personally pursued for commercial debts of the SCSp

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies only if the SCSp exceeds two of the three criteria for two consecutive financial years: balance-sheet total EUR 4.4 million, net turnover EUR 8.8 million, average workforce of 50 employees; otherwise audit-exempt
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP pursuant to the Law of 19 December 2002 as amended as the default framework; IFRS as adopted by the EU is permitted where consolidated accounts are required or voluntarily elected

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SCSp must identify all beneficial owners holding, directly or indirectly, at least 25% of ownership interests or voting rights in the RBE; the RCS annual declaration requires re-confirmation that UBO data is unchanged, while any share-transfer or ownership change must be filed separately within one month of the transaction
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Limited Partners (registre des commanditaires)
Register of General Partners and their Capital Contributions (associes commandites)
Minute Book of Partner Resolutions and Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,600 - USD 3,800 per annum for a Luxembourg registered office and corporate agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,300 - USD 9,000 per annual Luxembourg GAAP audit engagement for a typical small commercial SCSp

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% aggregate Luxembourg City headline rate (CIT 17% + solidarity surcharge 1.19% + municipal business tax 6.75%); fiscally transparent SCSp is exempt from CIT at the partnership level.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: SCSp default pass-through: 0% Luxembourg CIT at entity level, partners taxed pro rata. IP Box regime (Art. 50ter LIR): 80% exemption of net qualifying IP income, effective rate +/−5%. Participation exemption: 100% of qualifying dividends and capital gains (>=10% holding or >=EUR 1.2M cost, 12-month holding). Notional interest deduction abolished for new borrowings from 2021.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (statutory annual utilization cap: 17% of taxable income exceeding EUR 25,000)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 201 (Corporate Income Tax, Municipal Business Tax and Net Wealth Tax return) filed via the ACD eTVA electronic portal / MyGuichet. Fiscally transparent SCSp: partnership-level allocation statement filed by the SCSp; each partner then assessed individually on allocated profit.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Statutory deadline: 31 March following the fiscal year-end. Automatic extension to 31 December of the following calendar year when filed electronically via eTVA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: SCSp name, RCS registration number, registered office address, fiscal year end, date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the SCSp's Luxembourg tax identification number (NIF) and, if no permanent establishment, declare the SCSp as transparent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal form (SCSp), partnership agreement date, general partner identity, activity code (ISIC 5911 animation/VFX production), number of employees, substance indicators (premises, payroll, bank account).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners must not be listed as corporate taxpayers in this section; the SCSp acts only as reporting intermediary.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of partnership-level taxable income: gross animation service revenue, direct production costs, salaries, depreciation, amortization of 3D character/IP, and net business result per Luxembourg tax accounting rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate taxable income to each partner according to the partnership agreement share; income of non-resident limited partners without a Luxembourg PE is generally outside Luxembourg tax jurisdiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Carryforward losses of the partnership, capped at 17% of the taxable base exceeding EUR 25,000 per partner per year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners claim the loss allocation in their residence country only; Luxembourg does not grant personal loss relief to non-residents absent a PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annex listing each partner: full name, address, tax residence, profit share, allocated taxable income, and any EU/domestic withholding credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach Form 61 residence certificates of all non-resident partners; reduced treaty rates or exemption are applied on that basis.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: administrative fine of EUR 25 to EUR 2,500 per return; default interest of 0.6% per month on underpaid tax; forced assessment (taxation d'office) with a 10% mark-up over the assessed tax; coercive fine up to EUR 25,000 for continued non-compliance after formal notice.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% domestic rate; reduced to 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive and domestic participation exemption for qualifying holdings (>=10% or >=EUR 1.2M, 12 months). Distributions from a fiscally transparent SCSp are profit allocations, not dividends, and are generally outside Luxembourg WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Partner obtains a Luxembourg tax residence certificate (Form 61) from the ACD; submits it to the SCSp/payer before payment; the payer applies the treaty rate at source. If excess WHT is withheld, a refund claim must be filed with the ACD within 5 years under the General Tax Law. For EU cross-border payments, the Interest and Royalties Directive and Parent-Subsidiary Directive relief is granted upon presentation of the TRC and a holding period declaration; substance checks apply.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Luxembourg domestic law imposes no withholding tax on outbound interest or royalties (0%); treaty rates are therefore inoperative for outbound payments. Inbound royalties to a Luxembourg company are exempt from WHT where the beneficial owner is a qualifying EU resident, otherwise the domestic 0% statutory rate applies.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Master File and Local File mandatory where the group's consolidated annual turnover exceeds EUR 750,000,000 and intra-group cross-border transactions exceed: EUR 500,000 (financial transactions), EUR 250,000 (intangible/IP transactions), or EUR 1,000,000 (goods and services). Country-by-Country Report threshold: consolidated turnover above EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No standalone Economic Substance Regulations are enacted in Luxembourg, but substance is decisive: the ATAD-derived General Anti-Abuse Rule (Art. 6a StAnpG), the OECD MLI Principal Purpose Test, and the abuse-of-law doctrine can deny treaty benefits, recharacterize financing, and void arrangements lacking economic substance. An SCSp producing 3D animation must demonstrate real activities (production staff, servers/workstations, management decisions, Luxembourg bank account, executed client contracts) to preserve pass-through treatment and treaty access.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Tax Fraud (Fraude Fiscale)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of revenue, falsified production invoices, undisclosed offshore bank accounts, fictitious subcontractor payments, or use of the SCSp to conceal taxable income from animation/rendering services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to EUR 250,000 (aggravated fraud: up to twice the evaded tax) and imprisonment of 8 days to 5 years; reassessment at the 24.94% aggregate rate; default interest at 0.6% per month; publication of the conviction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: General partner (gérant) of the SCSp is jointly and severally liable without limit; directors incur personal criminal fines, confiscation orders, travel bans, extradition exposure, and imprisonment up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File and Administrative Non-Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Non-filing of Form 201, absence of the partnership allocation statement, non-registration with the ACD, or rejection of an eTVA filing request; systematic non-compliance with the 31 March/31 December deadlines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Coercive fine up to EUR 25,000; forced assessment (taxation d'office) with 10% mark-up; default interest at 0.6% per month; loss of deductions and loss carryforward; denial of foreign tax credits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the general partner may be held personally liable for the corporate tax debt where the failure results from serious mismanagement (Art. 510-1 LSC); risk of bankruptcy clawback and management prohibition.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Substance Failure (GAAR / Treaty Abuse)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: SCSp with zero employees, nominee general partner, no Luxembourg bank account or premises, backdated partnership agreements, artificial routing of 3D animation royalties through the SCSp to avoid source-state taxation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Application of Art. 6a StAnpG and OECD PPT: profits recharacterized and taxed at the partner level, treaty benefits denied, additional tax assessments with 0.6% monthly interest and penalty surcharges up to 10%; potential criminal referral for fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil pierced where the SCSp is a sham; limited partners lose limited-liability protection if they participate in management; general partner retains unlimited personal liability; residence-state tax authorities impose secondary adjustments and travel bans.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML, Beneficial Ownership and Money Laundering
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to register ultimate beneficial owners in the Luxembourg RBE register within 30 days; failure to maintain AML policies; laundering of proceeds through the SCSp's Wise B2B or Swift wire payment rails; accepting anonymous investor deposits for animation funding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RBE non-compliance: administrative fines up to EUR 125,000. Money laundering: imprisonment up to 5 years and fines up to EUR 1,000,000 or twice the value of the laundered property; freezing orders and confiscation of the 3D animation assets and IP.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and AML compliance officers personally liable for fines; travel bans, house arrest, and prohibition from serving as directors; personal criminal conviction and extradition under mutual legal assistance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intercompany service fees, character IP royalties, or production advances paid to related parties without an arm's length benchmark; absence of Local File/Master File upon ACD request; artificial profit stripping through management fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ACD TP adjustment reallocating profit to the SCSp; additional CIT assessed at 24.94%; 0.6% monthly late interest; 10% penalty surcharge; adjusted amounts recharacterized as constructive distributions and subject to 15% WHT where applicable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign inaccurate TP documentation face personal fines for false declarations; general partner exposure extends to the full underpaid tax plus penalties; criminal referral in cases of deliberate documentation forgery.
